LLDAP_JWT_SECRET.description: Random secret for JWT signatures. Changing it invalidates all user sessions.

LLDAP_KEY_SEED.description: Random seed for the server private key that protects stored passwords. Keep it stable — losing it locks out password verification.

LLDAP_LDAP_USER_PASS.description: Admin password for the web UI and LDAP bind (user admin). Seeded once on first boot; changing it later does not reset the password.
